find: const fill = quality.fillRimLights ? new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xbcd0ff, 0.55) : null;
replace: const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xbcd0ff, 0.55) as THREE.DirectionalLight | null;
why: Issue #735. A DISCLOSED SURVIVOR, not an equivalent mutant: the fill light is built even under ?fillRimLights=off, so the override removes only the rim and a sweep measures a scene with one extra light it believes absent. It survives because nothing vitest runs reaches createScene past its WebGLRenderer, which jsdom cannot provide; `.claude/rules/rendering.md` puts scene.ts under the real-browser GL harness instead. What kills it is tools/gl/harness.ts's 'a fillRimLights override builds the sun and the ambient light and nothing else (issue #735)'. The cast keeps `if (fill)` below type-correct.
